string.text: A stout ammunition crate for the settlement's guns. Settlement storage: settlers and Auto-Sort put weapons, ammunition and grenades in it first, and take what they need from it. Holds 250 kg.
A metal locker for the settlement's protective gear. Settlement storage: settlers and Auto-Sort put suits, armour, helmets and gas masks in it first. Holds 250 kg.
A food chest for supplies that keep. Settlement storage: food and drink go to a fridge first, then here. Holds 200 kg.
A large crate for everything else the settlement owns: parts, tools, materials and odds and ends. Settlement storage, and the camp's main chest when it has one. Holds 300 kg.
A medical case for the settlement's medicine. Settlement storage: medkits, bandages, drugs and anti-rad go here first. Holds 100 kg.
